verdict.rationale: The evidence shows telli publishes its own MCP server, which lets external AI tools talk to Charlie. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. The only related feature is Custom Tools, which connect agents to your own APIs; that is a different integration path, not plugging in MCP servers. Nothing documents telli agents or Charlie consuming third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
